description: Dated spot fee profiles for the paper broker and the practice range (T28, D126, D146). Rates are per side and charged in the quote asset. Revisions are append-only: a changed fee is a new revision with its own date, never an edit of a published one. Each revision is pinned by content hash in src/trade_graph/kernel/cost_profiles.py.

profiles.title: Kraken spot, starting tier
profiles.tier: Lowest public spot tier: 30-day trading volume up to USD10,000

sources.title: Kraken fee schedule (source S08)
sources.note: Figure from the 2026-09-29 official review recorded in docs/07-COSTS.md, D14 and D126 (0.40% maker, 0.80% taker per side). The cloud build session could not reach kraken.com on 2026-10-16 (the network policy refused the connection), so the build-plan figure is kept; re-check at step L2. The owner's actual account tier, read through Kraken's trade-volume endpoint (S12), outranks this public figure.

profiles.note: The paper broker's default fees. Same rates as the earlier fixed conservative tier (D14), now as a dated record.

profiles.title: Kraken spot, after USD10,000 of 30-day volume
profiles.tier: The public spot tier above USD10,000 of 30-day trading volume

sources.title: Kraken fee schedule (source S08)
sources.note: Figure from the 2026-10-12 venue session that D126 records, corrected against official fee pages (0.22% maker, 0.38% taker per side; 0.44% and 0.76% per round trip). The cloud build session could not reach kraken.com on 2026-10-16 (the network policy refused the connection), so the build-plan figure is kept; re-check at step L2.

profiles.note: What the same strategy would cost once the account's 30-day volume passes USD10,000. Not a claim that the paper account has that volume.
